purpose: Evidence-grounded current-system fit and implementation recommendation; not live acceptance or code

P05.name: October 2 managing-agent audit
P05.source_locations: Q references and original 715-line audit positions

P06.name: User-pasted focused Brain PC report
P06.coverage: A plus B1-B5 and partial B6

status_interpretation: An existing schema/prompt is not a deployed end-to-end workflow. NOT_FOUND means not found in the inspected report scope, not proved absent from every device.

memories.name: Source material, identity and version memory
memories.current_finding: Originals and stable source/version records exist. Registration/coverage differs by course. No complete source-ID to Drive-file-ID mapping or immutable historical blob archive was established.
memories.authority: Existing course source owner and protected tracking publisher
implementation: Preserve IDs, path aliases, roles and source versions. Add a narrowly reviewed storage resolver mapping to Drive IDs without replacing academic identities.
Use source/version/locator to resolve current permitted bytes and a rendition. Verify bytes separately from metadata and remote-delivery claims.
Retain all-lecture inventory including empty, unavailable, unrecorded and unindexed material. Where old bytes are needed, retain authorized snapshots or report unavailability honestly.
memories.rationale: Navigation and historical evidence require stable identity; filename equality, a Drive folder listing and a checksum alone are insufficient.
acceptance: Reordered/renamed/re-exported source does not attach old notes to a new slide silently.
All inventoried lectures remain accounted for; no old source is regenerated and presented as original.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Precise source links and media/rendition memory
memories.current_finding: BE 505 reviewed source maps link slide/page ranges to transcript lines; some renders/views exist. Verified recording intervals and universal typed anchors/renditions were not established.
memories.authority: Existing source-map/catalog owner; new timing annotations need an explicit approved owned record
locations: .cache/ and exports/ for versioned allowed renditions
implementation: Inspect originals, timing basis, transcript fidelity and visible video before selecting processing. Keep displayed-slide links distinct from concept-discussion links.

Derive normalized anchors from existing reviewed maps where possible. New reviewed timestamps are genuinely new annotations: adopt a minimal versioned representation under the SAME source-link owner, and declare which record is authoritative before publishing.
Do not pretend an export alone preserves a manual correction. Persist the accepted original assertion, predecessor, source versions, support and review status; regenerate exports from it.
Use many-to-many ranges, media time origin, page/printed-page distinctions, evidence and unresolved states. Never strengthen a paragraph/chapter reference into an exact page.
memories.rationale: A gap summary is derived evidence, but a newly reviewed audio interval is new information and must have a durable owner. Treating both as disposable exports loses corrections.
acceptance: An accepted correction survives deletion/rebuilding of derived alignment output.
Old prose and normalized records cannot become two independently editable authorities for the same assertion.
Unrecorded audio cannot yield a confirmed original recording interval.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Course policy, learning goals and preferences
memories.current_finding: Course instructions, context, learning strategies, mode and study-choice vocabulary exist. An automated receipt of what each native turn actually loaded is not universal.
memories.authority: Course policy/strategy owner; user intent and permissions
implementation: Load trusted course/mode instructions explicitly and log selected versions in a bounded context receipt.
Keep develop/maintain/reference_only/defer/undecided choices distinct from performance. Preserve course-specific assistance boundaries.
No request, retrieved document, or generated summary can modify its own permissions, spending or trusted strategy.
memories.rationale: A file existing is not evidence it entered the model context, and study priority is not competence.
acceptance: Course A cannot inherit course B answer-reveal policy accidentally.
A hostile source instruction cannot expand a tool or canonical write permission.
memories.producer_qualification: Trusted user/course-policy owner only; ordinary task/worker input cannot self-modify policy.

memories.name: Concept, topic, skill and relationship memory
memories.current_finding: Skills/topics and families exist in each course; BE 505 has a richer concept/question/criterion index. No uniform independent concept graph is installed or needed as duplicate authority.
memories.authority: Owning course catalogs and reviewed shared mappings
implementation: Normalize read models over existing typed IDs. A display node references its true concept/topic/skill/question kind.
Keep strict_containment, partial_overlap and diagnostic_prerequisite on their actual question endpoints; do not relabel them as universal concept-part or curriculum prerequisites.

Create multilayer views with bounded traversal, visited-node guards and multiple references to one ID. Apply acyclicity only to a relation whose contract requires it; related/concept discussions can have cycles.
For an unmapped course concept, propose the smallest source-backed extension to that course owner; do not silently install the full BE 505 schema everywhere.
memories.rationale: The useful graph already starts in the catalogs. A second definition store would split identities, misstate relationships and fragment learning history.
acceptance: One concept in several tree branches produces one logical identity and no extra performances.
Question containment is not converted into a false concept hierarchy; missing mapping is a system-coverage gap.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Question, rubric and answer-exposure memory
memories.current_finding: All courses have family/rubric records; BE 505 has exact questions and criteria. Tutor-authored guides and original prompts have different authority; solution separation is not fully access-enforced.
implementation: Prefer existing questions and rubric versions, including diagrams and givens. Keep source prompts authoritative where catalog prompt is intentionally null.
Pin the intended family/skills before assessment and record whether the rubric is instructor-supplied or tutor-authored. A model answer is not automatically a key.
Prevent unintended answer material from entering question-only context. UI collapse is not permission control. Stage unsupported alternative answers/rubric changes for appropriate review.
memories.rationale: A valid rubric reference can still be pedagogically incorrect; disclosure changes the meaning of a later attempt.
acceptance: Question-only mode cannot obtain solution text through another supplied field.
New question versions do not rewrite prompts/rubrics used by older attempts.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Complete submitted interaction and attachments
memories.current_finding: Native history and excerpts/locators exist. Guaranteed immutable capture of every submitted prompt/response plus full delivered reply and attachments is not implemented. Existing locators are not hash validators.
memories.authority: New operational evidence capture owner around the existing learning writer
implementation: Capture full shown question, actual learner answer, modalities, required figures, assistance and time basis before inference. Preserve input even if grading fails or is unavailable.
Freeze and read back the learner snapshot; store later tutor messages separately. Transport retries keep one logical learner response even when dispatch/run IDs change.

Verify relative path, bytes, source and item identity, attachment digests and exact excerpt around publication. Unicode/transcript normalization must be explicit rather than silently changing original text.
Raw voice retention remains a separate choice. If only text is permitted, preserve the exact transcript as text evidence and mark the raw audio unavailable.
Do not put snapshots or new record kinds in learning/attempts, and do not backfill missing historical content with AI.
memories.rationale: The user requested complete future interaction evidence; the existing compact record format can point to it without becoming a competing attempt schema.
acceptance: Question/learner snapshot survives a model failure; later reply does not change its digest.
An altered attachment, wrong course/turn or missing excerpt blocks a verified save/reuse claim.
Identical native-result retry does not become a second learner message.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Assessed attempts, assistance and correction history
memories.current_finding: Immutable attempts and per-skill judgments are real. Assessment_revision is supported by contract/code; P05 found zero real revisions, so production correction behavior is not demonstrated merely by the schema.
memories.authority: Existing course-learning-v1 owner; BE 505 helper and other coordinated writers
implementation: Keep exact required fields, outcome enums, time semantics and one intended family/skill set. New responses create new attempts; regrades create one connected nonbranching same-skill assessment-revision chain.
Use the full-turn verifier before and around the real save. Retain saved/already_saved/view-stale distinctions.
For other courses, build a tested common facade for the prescribed no-clobber procedure; do not claim an existing universal save executable.
Isolate/fix BE 505 global ROOT/path dependencies before any fixture save. Do not send learning attempts through the separate tracking publisher.
memories.rationale: Replacing an established learner-history format creates risk without adding learning value. The missing work is reliable capture, actual integration and safer writer portability.
acceptance: Same ID/same bytes reuses evidence; same ID/different bytes conflicts.
No error diagnosis on not_observed; corrections preserve original question, response, occurrence time and skill set.
View failure after saved attempt never causes a new attempt.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Learning gaps, possible causes and remediation state
memories.current_finding: Missing/incorrect content, error categories and analysis already belong in observations. Narrative roadmaps and prompted diagnostics exist; no automated persistent hypothesis workflow or dedicated derived gap view was found.
memories.authority: Effective canonical attempts/revisions for performance; operational proposals for unresolved explanations
locations: existing observation fields and study roadmaps
implementation: Compute current evidence from effective correction chains and comparable skills/conditions, keeping supporting and contradicting attempts visible.
Separate observed error, possible cause, question that discriminates between causes, and chosen next action. Operational candidate causes must never count as diagnosed learner failures.
Use only actual criterion IDs where available; otherwise stay at validated skill/family granularity instead of inventing fine-grained measurements.
For each real next answer use WF05, then update or close the hypothesis under explicit policy. Assisted correction is not independent retention; passage of time is not forgetting evidence.
If a required diagnosis cannot be represented without ambiguity in current analysis, propose a reviewed extension to the existing observation owner, not a second canonical gap ledger.
memories.rationale: The user needs a useful gap dashboard, not another database competing with the original evidence. Root causes are hypotheses until demonstrated.
acceptance: Correcting a mistaken grader retracts the derived finding without deleting the original response.
A failed advanced task cannot mark all graph ancestors weak.
New conflicting/comparable evidence is visible; neither latest answer nor highest confidence blindly erases history.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Progress summaries and learning-state displays
memories.current_finding: learning-state.md and helpers derive learning evidence; some saved views are stale. Counts and priorities are not calibrated mastery, retention or transfer probabilities.
memories.authority: Existing course/shared rendering owners; outputs are derived
implementation: Verify originals and effective revisions before deriving/displaying facts; show staleness when current regeneration is unavailable.
Build source-linked observations, assistance, timestamps and counterevidence into the UI; do not present unobserved as failure.

Define complete new projection input manifests including relevant schema/helper/policy versions. Do not retroactively call an old valid attempt false simply because a model/tool version later changed.
memories.rationale: The existing summaries are useful. Unchecked freshness and overinterpreted percentages, not the Markdown format, are the weaknesses.
acceptance: Deleting an export loses no canonical attempt; rebuilding reflects current effective revisions.
Zero recorded attempts displays unassessed; stale view is not reported as lost history.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Cross-course reference memory
memories.current_finding: Reviewed shared mappings link limited course skills and reference original attempts. Broader staged work is not established as active.
implementation: Read approved equivalence/related distinctions and original attempt IDs; stage new connections for the shared owner.
Show potential transfer as a question to test under the new conditions, never grant it from a connection alone.
Do not let an ordinary course tutor publish shared mappings or copy source attempts as new performances.
memories.rationale: Cross-course browsing is valuable, but equivalence of labels/content is not evidence of the learner performing the new skill.
acceptance: The same original attempt referenced by two courses is counted once in the shared view.
Staged or related mappings cannot award equivalent performance.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Review selection, scheduling and review-event memory
memories.current_finding: review_suggestion and study choices exist; no working adaptive scheduler, due queue or active two-way Anki integration was found.
memories.authority: One approved scheduling owner; canonical learning evidence remains in attempts
locations: proposed selected item/configuration and immutable review events under existing operational run role
implementation: Adopt an established scheduling implementation only after checking its required inputs and actual task fit; no fixed tool/version is selected by this source review.
Persist user selection/suspension, item/question revision, scheduler configuration/version, actual review time, attempt reference and supported rating basis.

Append one event per actual review; uncertain judgments require abstention/manual policy, not automatic failure. A changed item or corrected grading recomputes versioned due state without inserting a new learner review.
Scheduling metadata is authoritative for scheduling only. Do not create Calendar/Tasks events or reminders without separate permission.
memories.rationale: The application genuinely lacks a scheduling process; implementing it does not require replacing the established learning history.
acceptance: A question created but not selected never becomes automatically due.
Identical review retry updates the schedule once, and no learner reply creates no review.
A scheduler change preserves observed review history and identifies the policy used.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Session resume, drafts and device continuity
memories.current_finding: Session/thread IDs and roadmaps preserve some context. No unified cross-device last-slide/playback/draft/selected-question state was found.
memories.authority: User/device session events reconciled by the PC coordinator
locations: existing native thread/session references and work roadmaps
proposed operational session checkpoints and per-device input revisions
implementation: Keep app session, native thread, learner turn, request and dispatch attempt identities separate.
Persist slide/source revision, playback position, selected pane/question and saved draft under device revision/parent lineage. Clock time alone does not select the winner.
An edited submitted answer is new explicitly linked input; ordinary draft autosave is not assessment evidence. Capture and show wait/cancel/blocked states.
memories.rationale: Cross-device continuity is new UX state, not new competence memory. It should survive restarts without grading activity the learner did not submit.
acceptance: Two devices editing the same draft surface a conflict or preserved branches rather than silent last-write-wins.
A stale slide position cannot resume on a different slide after deck revision.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Retrieved working context and compact summaries
memories.current_finding: Instructions and maintained helpers support selective retrieval, but no universally enforced startup/context-budget service or full native-thread handoff was established.
memories.authority: Original source/catalog/attempt owners; context is derived ephemeral work evidence
locations: operational compact summaries referencing original turns
implementation: Retrieve trusted mode/course policy, exact presented material/rubric, relevant typed graph neighborhood and original effective attempts with counterevidence.
Frame the current attempt against the rubric before using prior judgments to hypothesize a cause. Do not let repeated negative summaries predetermine a grade.
Record what content and tool outputs were actually supplied, not only intended filenames; missing or uncertain native context remains explicit.
Pin inputs and generation policy for optional prose summaries, but do not claim that LLM wording is deterministically reproducible. Structured gap/tree fields should rebuild deterministically.
When a tree is absent, fall back to available original source; block only the claim that requires missing evidence.
memories.rationale: Durable records are not useful unless the worker receives the right small subset. Summaries must not amplify stale or mistaken assessments.
acceptance: A retracted assessment cannot survive as an unqualified weakness in a newer working summary.
Hidden answer keys and unrelated private history are excluded from question-only requests.
A referenced file is not recorded as loaded unless actual access is established.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Operational queue, native runs, receipts and recovery memory
memories.current_finding: Scheduled native jobs and publication receipts exist. Resident learning-app admission, exact dispatch correlation and independent terminal return remain unproven; the default control connection failed in P06.
memories.authority: PC supervisor for execution journal; course writers retain canonical authority
locations: existing automation/ receipts and source updater jobs
Drive immutable request/result bundles and exported task.md dashboards (proposed)
implementation: Observe committed manifests, validate the authorized namespace and payload hashes, deduplicate, claim bounded ready work, then dispatch only through a verified native route.
Separate request/learner turn/dispatch attempt/native run/publication IDs; version-scoped leases only control accepted app publication, not arbitrary native side effects.
Persist before/after receipts and recognize uncertain completion. Continue other ready tasks while a blocked item awaits source, user, quota or approval.
Per-thread turns and canonical writes are serialized. Reuse the existing source updater instead of installing another polling LLM or source publisher.
memories.rationale: The always-on PC provides the execution location, not a working trigger/return or universal lock by itself.
acceptance: Duplicate event never duplicates a learner attempt; same ID with different bytes conflicts.
Unknown prior execution is reconciled before retry; idle state issues zero reasoning calls.
A native tool seeing a response is not enough unless the resident process can obtain its terminal result.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

memories.name: Retention, historical evidence and backup/recovery lifecycle
memories.current_finding: Immutable records and tracking recovery artifacts exist; no general full-turn retention/deletion or cross-device restore guarantee was established. Some historical bytes may no longer exist.
memories.authority: Existing course/record owners and an approved backup/retention operator
locations: existing attempt and publication recovery artifacts
authorized backup location and inventory (not selected here)
implementation: Referenced full-turn snapshots must not be deleted as generic run scratch. Distinguish durable evidence, pending proposals and disposable render caches.
Record retention choices for voice, images, messages, native/provider history and backup copies separately. A local delete is not provider-wide erasure.
Use dependency-aware export/deletion and explicit unavailable/redacted states without silently rewriting historical answers.
Exercise backups/restoration on a controlled copy and preserve newer records during recovery. No broad production cleanup is authorized.
memories.rationale: An immutable attempt is not reproducible when its only full response/figure was cleaned from an operational directory. Retention is a real data contract.
acceptance: Cleanup cannot remove a referenced snapshot while reporting the attempt fully verifiable.
Restoration never overwrites newer valid state; local and provider deletion outcomes remain distinct.
memories.producer_qualification: A workflow stages/publishes only through the listed existing owner; projection writers do not own the underlying fact.

workflow_fit.current: Existing scheduled jobs are real, but immediate submitted-task admission, independent native-thread roundtrip and app correlation are not operationally established.
workflow_fit.why: Monitoring and queue control are ordinary software; native reasoning must be called only through a tested target/return boundary.
workflow_fit.writes: Local journal/claims first; then correlated acknowledgment, staged result and Drive-visible receipts. Never route by the globally last chat.
workflow_fit.proof: A synthetic independent-process roundtrip must verify target, permissions and terminal return; duplicates, cancelled generations and zero idle model calls are separate cases.

workflow_fit.current: The installed source refresh and protected publication have historical receipts; current processing is bounded (reported at most three sources per course/run).
workflow_fit.why: A second source scheduler/publisher creates conflicting identity/review decisions. A bounded batch is fine; forgetting the remaining backlog is not.
workflow_fit.writes: Existing source publication only via its owner; a small receipt extension identifies changed source versions, actual checks, processed frontier and remaining work for downstream preparation.
workflow_fit.proof: Several batches account for every inventoried source without a new competing updater; repeated receipt is a no-op; empty/unrecorded items never become aligned.

workflow_fit.current: Reviewed slide-to-transcript-line maps and selected render assets exist; complete timing, typed anchors and browser media delivery do not.
workflow_fit.why: Reuse existing reviewed work but do not call transcript line numbers recording seconds. Preserve new manual timing assertions durably.
workflow_fit.writes: Versioned cache/renditions; candidate anchors; reviewed owner-compatible alignment record; derived source-linked export with coverage and uncertainty.
workflow_fit.proof: Repeated/off-slide/partial-transcript cases and manual correction replay are checked against real media; confirmed quality is separate from syntax-valid export.

workflow_fit.current: Agents curate skills/families and the richer BE 505 question structure; no automatic all-lecture semantic extractor/tree publisher is established.
workflow_fit.why: New material should extend the owned catalog, not spawn a duplicate graph authority or prerequisite forest.
workflow_fit.writes: Scoped catalog deltas through owner; source-backed proposal/evidence receipts; concept-tree export with typed nodes and original relation semantics.
workflow_fit.proof: Stable IDs reused, incompatible relation directions rejected, duplicate visual branches yield one logical node, and no student assessment is created.

workflow_fit.current: There are real native explanations and reusable lookup helpers; their externally triggered app path, complete record capture and process-readable return remain missing.
workflow_fit.why: The teaching behavior exists. The app needs exact context, request identity and visible history without treating help as failure.
workflow_fit.writes: Full committed question sidecar, actual-context receipt, separate delivered answer, verified result manifest and later resume projection.
workflow_fit.proof: Correct source/figure/question version reaches the correct thread and user; no attempt is fabricated merely because an explanation was requested.

workflow_fit.current: Actual attempts preserve outcome/assistance; BE 505 has a helper and other courses coordinated procedures. No general sidecar-integrity verifier or uniform safe save service exists.
workflow_fit.why: The correct improvement is a reliable interface to existing history, not a replacement gradebook or every-answer-is-new-performance rule.
workflow_fit.writes: Frozen learner turn before inference; pinned rubric/conditions receipt; validated existing-format attempt or explicit pending state; separate tutor reply; writer/readback receipt; view-update request.
workflow_fit.proof: Unknown timing stays unknown; unsupported family/skill set blocks the candidate but not original capture; retries/regrading do not duplicate the response; saved evidence survives renderer failure.

workflow_fit.current: Optional follow-up, help labeling and tutor-error acknowledgment exist in behavior/notes; no formal bounded multi-hypothesis workflow or waiting lifecycle is installed.
workflow_fit.why: Mistakes have alternative explanations. Persistent proposals help continuity without falsely creating canonical root-cause diagnoses.
workflow_fit.writes: Candidate cause/question/proposal; immutable delivered diagnostic prompt and actual subsequent answer; WF05 assessment; derived gap view after valid canonical changes.
workflow_fit.proof: Two or three bounded diagnostic steps are a proposed default, not a forced minimum; WAITING_USER releases the worker; no new evidence is imagined to finish the queue.

workflow_fit.current: Question/family authoring and a substantial BE 505 bank exist; a uniform versioned selectable rich-card workflow does not.
workflow_fit.why: The goal is useful coverage, not many generated cards. A new prompt may reuse a family without duplicating its definition.
workflow_fit.writes: Catalog-owned question/family revision only when needed; separate selected review-item/configuration and source-linked derived view; no learner attempt.
workflow_fit.proof: Source-supported solvability, valid alternatives, disclosure boundaries and intentional selection are checked; item edits do not rewrite old reviewed content.

workflow_fit.current: Suggestions and reminders are not a functioning spaced-review system; no active adaptive review event engine or two-way card synchronization was found.
workflow_fit.why: Scheduling is a genuinely missing conventional service. Misconception diagnosis remains WF06 and competence remains canonical attempts.
workflow_fit.writes: Versioned item selection/configuration; one review event per submitted response tied to WF05 attempt; deterministic due queue; explicit suspended/uncertain state.
workflow_fit.proof: The same review is applied once; no answer gives WAITING_USER; assisted/uncertain results are not silently independent success or failure; regrade changes projections, not historical event count.

workflow_fit.current: assessment_revision and controlled tracking recovery are implemented contracts; P05 had no actual production assessment revisions and no universal dependency invalidation graph.
workflow_fit.why: Different errors require different owners. A changed graph label or tool version must not silently rewrite learner history.
workflow_fit.writes: Existing-format assessment revision or source/catalog annotation through owner; expected-predecessor checks; supersession receipts; scoped regeneration tasks.
workflow_fit.proof: Same intended skills, original prompt/response/time, single nonbranching correction chain; competing branches stop; view-only edit does not regrade an attempt.

workflow_fit.current: Learning/shared renderers and some study exports exist, with reported stale views. No universal concept-tree/gap/review/resume view producer exists.
workflow_fit.why: Rebuilding trusted views is safer than asking an LLM to overwrite one cumulative memory file. Current facts must come from original effective evidence.
workflow_fit.writes: Existing views through owners; proposed tree/gap/review exports; actual-source-linked session summary; complete export manifest and app task dashboards.
workflow_fit.proof: Deterministic structured facts rebuild from owned inputs. Model-written prose summaries are identified as replaceable generated wording, not guaranteed byte-identical regeneration or new observations.

workflow_fit.current: Some guarded publisher recovery and historical fixtures exist; no current companion or verified lock-screen/reboot/native-update/Drive-reconnect lifecycle was established.
workflow_fit.why: Always-on hardware does not make authentication, synchronization or native execution outcomes infallible. Recovery must preserve exact prior effects.
workflow_fit.writes: Minimal local health/incident/backup receipts and Drive-visible status; verified repair/recovery results; no unapproved model/tool/permission change.
workflow_fit.proof: Reconcile uncertain native and canonical receipts before retry; preserve referenced sidecars in backup/cleanup; old lock is not deleted blindly; no autonomous expensive self-repair loop.
